text:
Asha (Marketing): hey team - need a compact visual kit for next Wednesday's webinar + the inbound landing page. timeline tight: final assets by Tue EOD. main asks below, pls confirm feasibility. :pray:

Asha (Marketing): deliverables: 1) 3 social carousel images (square) 2) 2 hero header options for landing (desktop & mobile) 3) one data diagram (latency vs $/token curve) 4) slide-ready benchmark one-pager (A4/16:9 export) 5) small animated CTA (30-60s Lottie) 6) alt text + copy variants for each asset

Asha (Marketing): brand constraints: use primary palette, don't add new typefaces, keep logo lockups consistent with recent deck. include an "SLA-friendly" variant (more conservative colors) for enterprise audiences.

Leo (Design): got it. quick Qs: - do you have a preferred headline/copy for the hero? - for the data diagram, is the source the internal token-cost dataset (Q1-Q4 2025) or the public benchmark?

Asha (Marketing): headline: "Make Inference Predictable: Cost, Latency, and Reliability" (flexible). subhead: "A practical playbook for production LLMs". use internal token-cost dataset (Q1-Q4 2025) + callouts for outliers.

Maria (Growth): also request mobile-first social variant (vertical story), and a 1-click header image for our LP that matches Pardot/Marketo crop ratios. Add UTM-ready filename convention when exporting pls.

Sam G (Demand): need a version of the benchmark one-pager with an anonymized customer callout (one short quote) — we can add the text; design should leave a reserved space.

Brand Ops: flag — avoid using the gradient behind text heavy blocks; follow brand contrast accessibility (AA). Palette reference: primary #0A2540, accent #00BFA6, warm #FFB166. Font family: Inter var + Redwood Display (heading).

Leo (Design): noted. I'll draft two layout options today and push figma frames. deliverable plan: mockups in Figma by EOD, first exports (JPEG/PNG + SVG + Lottie stub) by Mon morning. Is that okay?

Asha (Marketing): yes Mon morning for first exports works. Can you add alt text drafts inline in figma comments? Also include copy variants for CTA: [Register], [Save my seat], [Request a demo].

Leo (Design): will do. adding a small data viz spec: scatter w/ rolling-average line, log-scale y for $/token, shaded latency buckets. I'll include exact axis labels and CSV attachment in figma comments.

DesignBot: auto-check: recommended export sizes -> social square 1080x1080, story 1080x1920, hero desktop 1440x540, hero mobile 640x360, slide 1920x1080. Color contrast tests queued. :white_check_mark:

Brand Ops: pls avoid placing small text on top of patterned backgrounds. Also include a monochrome lockup for print.

Leo (Design): quick example color block I'm trying: ```Primary: #0A2540
Accent: #00BFA6
Warm: #FFB166``` will stick to those. Any objections?

Asha (Marketing): all good. Sam — do you want a version with logo partner placement?

Sam G (Demand): yes include partner spot (square 120x120) and a muted border treatment. I'll provide partner logo by Mon.

Maria (Growth): tagging distribution needs: filenames must include utm keys: asset_webinar_YYYYMMDD_role_variant (e.g., asset_webinar_20260327_social_marketing_v1). Also please add alt text CSV column: filename, alt_text, cta_variant.

Leo (Design): adding export naming and a small README frame in figma. Plan: share Figma link here once frames are up. ETA: figma link by 1862500600.

Asha (Marketing): thanks — one last ask: small set of onboarding notes for SDRs on how to use each asset (2-3 bullets). can someone draft that?

Sam G (Demand): I'll draft the SDR notes and drop into the figma comments + confluence page.

Brand Ops: final — please run final assets through contrast and logo spacing checklist before submit. We'll do a quick design review Tue morning.

Leo (Design): sounds good. I'll ping here when the mockups are up. :rocket:
